text: Is lending digital dollars worth it?
These Aave and Morpho products quote higher rates than a short-term Treasury fund. But fees and access to your money matter.
Over ninety days, Aave earns eleven dollars more than the Treasury fund after fees, if rates hold.
April's example used Aave version three. Today's products are different. Available cash is shared, so immediate withdrawals aren't guaranteed.
Better apps should explain earnings after fees, and how easily you can get your money back.
